title: My favourite flowering image: the Yellow Star-of-Bethlehem (Gagea lutea)
content: This article reflects on a paired image of Gagea lutea (Yellow Star-of-Bethlehem): a herbarium specimen collected in Scroggs Wood, Kendal, in 1880 and a contemporary photograph taken in 2024 at the same location.
siteTitle: Journal of Experimental Botany Current Issue
